title: Neon Sulfur (royal Blue)
description: This pack is one of a few that changes the minecraft sulfur cubes to be two colours: black and (insert colour here).
body:
Alright, where do I start...

Well, I've done it again. But what exactly have I done?
I have once again made many resorce packs for the same topic, this time it's the sulfur cube and its biome.

In this small series of packs, I plan to add neon variants of the sulfur cube (now known as the neon anomaly) that alter the colour of sulfur and cinnabar to be black and (insert colour here). There will be at least five packs in this collection of colours, all different hues, though differences not huge.

Screenshots?:
See the gallery tab.

Can I use these packs in my videos, modpacks etc?:
Yes, so long as you credit the creator(s) of the pack (myself).

Where are the other packs in this series posted?:
View my modrinth profile and scroll untill you find what you want, weather that's a sulfur-cube pack, or something else.

Other Questions?:
Feel free to join my [discord server](https://discord.gg/qh9H8jupfV) and ask anyone there.

Please enjoy the pack(s).
-Lime Imortal
